mapper.select: SELECT id, config_key AS configKey, config_value AS configValue, description, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM system_config WHERE config_key = #{configKey} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, config_key AS configKey, config_value AS configValue, description, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM system_config ORDER BY config_key ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO system_config ( config_key, config_value, description, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{configKey}, #{configValue}, #{description}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE system_config SET config_value = #{configValue}, description = #{description}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE config_key = #{configKey}
